name: ARDY Core RP — BF16 motion / INT4 encoder
description: ARDY denoiser and motion decoder in BF16 with a consolidated ConvRot INT4 LLM2Vec text encoder.

code.install: Use Download in the ARDY model card to install the ready BF16 motion / INT4 encoder bundle into ComfyUI/models/text_to_motion/ARDY-Core-RP-20FPS-Horizon40-int4/. Existing files are reused. No original ARDY or encoder repositories are downloaded.

requirements.notes: BF16 motion weights and BF16 neural computation; only the LLM2Vec text encoder uses ConvRot INT4. Measured on RTX 5070 Ti for a 2 s clip: 1.929 s warm generation; 4.18 GiB CUDA allocated, 4.31 GiB reserved; 31.12 GiB whole-process RSS during generation and 32.46 GiB across loading and generation. RAM includes other resident ComfyUI components. Baseline runs had different CUDA background allocations; approximate incremental generation allocation was 4.06 GiB. Memory depends on duration and other loaded nodes.

license.name: NVIDIA Open Model License / Meta Llama 3 Community License / MIT (LLM2Vec)

guide.summary: Default ARDY motion uses BF16 checkpoint weights and BF16 neural computation. LLM2Vec uses ConvRot INT4; sampling state, motion statistics and skeleton reconstruction retain FP32. Built with Meta Llama 3.
guide.best_for: Reducing weight storage and resident memory
guide.setup_effort: Download the prepared BF16 motion / INT4 encoder bundle in the model card
guide.speed: Measured: 1.929 s for a 2 s clip (warm, RTX 5070 Ti)

setup.label: BF16 motion and INT4 encoder (~4.15 GB)
setup.detail: Download the ready bundle from MIUProject/ARDY-Core-RP-20FPS-Horizon40-int4 into models/text_to_motion/ARDY-Core-RP-20FPS-Horizon40-int4/, including configuration, tokenizer, normalization statistics and licenses. Existing files are reused.
